crossRefs.note: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we…

translations.web: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
translations.bsb: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
translations.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
translations.asv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
